0022600138.text: The Rockets come in 3-0 and first in the Southwest, riding a three-game winning streak and a 2-0 road record, while the Bucks are 0-3 on a three-game losing streak, fifth in the Central and 3 games back, and 13th in the East. Houston is missing Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (calf strain), both listed as out, after averaging 7.5 points in 23.9 minutes per game and 4.0 points in 8.9 minutes per game this season. The teams have not yet met in 2026-27, but Houston won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 119-113 win over Milwaukee on April 1, 2026.
